decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures and utilizing Dredge cards to constantly recycle them back into play. By utilizing cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, the goal is to constantly bring back creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam for free, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of creatures. The deck also utilizes disruption like Grief and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having ways to protect the combo with Force of Negation and Mindbreak Trap.

The main strategy of this deck is to use the powerful Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine, enabling fast aggressive plays. With a high number of free counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Vigor, the deck aims to disrupt opposing strategies while maintaining its own momentum. By utilizing cards like Squee, Goblin Nabob and Master of Death for graveyard recursion, the deck can keep up the pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual and Mana Crypt, and then using this mana to cast a high number of spells in a single turn to create a storm count. The key goal is to assemble the Tendrils of Agony combo to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Cards like Bolas's Citadel, Time Walk, and Yawgmoth's Will are used to generate additional resources and dig deeper into the deck for combo pieces. Counter spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm are included to protect the combo from disruption.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies by utilizing disruptive artifacts like Null Rod and Sphere of Resistance, while also ramping up quickly with Mishra's Workshop and mana rocks. It aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats like Stonecoil Serpent and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, while also having access to powerful cards like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator for additional value and utility. The deck also has land disruption elements like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to disrupt opponents' mana base, making it difficult for them to stabilize and respond effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with important cards like Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Creeping Chill. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to facilitate dredging, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Mindbreak Trap also provides valuable protection against opposing strategies, allowing the deck to execute its combo game plan effectively.

The key concept of this deck is to use artifacts and fast mana acceleration to power out powerful spells like Paradoxical Outcome, Time Vault, and Yawgmoth's Will to generate a win condition quickly. It also utilizes card draw and control elements like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to cast cards from your graveyard and keep the pressure on your opponent. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently while balancing card advantage and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game quickly. It utilizes cards like Street Wraith and Thassa's Oracle to quickly draw through the deck and win with a well-timed Doomsday spell. The deck also includes powerful cards like Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Force of Will to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. With access to powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor, the deck aims to efficiently find and execute the combo while controlling the game with countermagic and disruption spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Shambling Shell using the Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. Once the graveyard is filled, the player can bring back creatures like Ichorid, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam to the battlefield repeatedly to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One provide additional damage and threats. Force of Will and Force of Negation offer protection, while Noxious Revival helps to recur key pieces. Chalice of the Void and Mindbreak Trap provide additional disruption against the opponent.

The deck focuses on using powerful artifact creatures and disruptive artifacts to quickly overwhelm and disrupt the opponent. By utilizing Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to ramp out threats early, as well as cards like Sphere of Resistance and Null Rod to slow down the opponent, the deck aims to create a board presence quickly and establish control of the game. Additionally, cards like Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland provide further disruption and resource denial, while Golos, Tireless Pilgrim helps to pull lands and other powerful artifacts from the deck to maintain pressure and advantage.

The main concept of this combo Dredge deck is to quickly dredge through the graveyard and put creatures into play from the graveyard for free. Bazaar of Baghdad is key to discarding cards and fueling the graveyard while cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp help dredge through the deck. The deck also utilizes cards like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba to bring back creatures for added board presence. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection while Hollow One and Grief add pressure to the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful graveyard strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hatebears like Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer. It looks to control the board by utilizing cards like Wasteland and Karakas, while also accelerating its own game plan with mana rocks like Black Lotus and Chrome Mox. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while applying consistent pressure to win the game quickly in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of the deck is to utilize graveyard interactions to quickly fill the board with powerful creatures like Stinkweed Imp, Prized Amalgam, and Narcomoeba. This allows for explosive plays and combos that can overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to chain together powerful graveyard interactions and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Creeping Chill, Ichorid, and Narcomoeba, then use graveyard synergies to bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Golgari Grave-Troll. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect the combo pieces. Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder help to dig through the deck and find key cards, while Hollow One provides additional threats. The strategy revolves around exploiting the graveyard and outpacing the opponent with fast combos.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful storm combo with cards like Tendrils of Agony and Bolas's Citadel to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells. The deck includes powerful draw and search spells like Ancestral Recall, Brainstorm, and Demonic Tutor to ensure consistency in finding key combo pieces. With powerful mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen, the deck aims to quickly cast multiple spells in a single turn to generate a lethal storm count. The inclusion of disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize helps protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on generating a massive amount of mana through artifact acceleration and card draw, then using Paradoxical Outcome to return those artifacts to hand and draw even more cards. The goal is to chain together spells, generate a large storm count, and potentially win the game with a large Tendrils of Agony or Brain Freeze. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion gives the deck additional value by allowing for recursion of key permanents. Overall, the deck aims to assemble a lethal storm combo while disrupting opponents with countermagic and various control elements.

This deck focuses on using control elements, disruption, and card advantage to outlast and outmaneuver opponents. The key strategy involves utilizing powerful spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the board while also leveraging card draw with Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of powerful mana accelerants like Black Lotus and Moxen allows for explosive starts and the ability to cast multiple spells per turn. Additionally, the presence of a flexible sideboard option in Lurrus of the Dream-Den adds versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.
